run.command: strata bench run --url http://127.0.0.1:8080 --suite standard-v1 --track custom --track-notes Strata 0.2.1 source install, engine 0.1.46.1. Hand-written run config: GGUF in place (--native, no experts.bin), --resident-budget-gib 80 so all experts stay in RAM, --kv int8 --kv-resident 32768, MTP draft layer, control vector (experimental speed projection) on. GPU power limit 200 W (nvidia-power-limit.service). Server bound to 127.0.0.1 for the run; no other clients. --quantization UD-Q4_K_XL (Unsloth dynamic, GGUF in place) --custom-pack packs/unsloth-ud-q4_k_xl built by tools/iq_pack.py --compat-bf16 from Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-UD-Q4_K_XL-00001-of-00004.gguf --source-revision 9ae93f7b --build-options CUDA 13.2.2, sm_86, GCC 15.2, setup.py build (STRATA_MMQ_KQUANTS=ON default), 200 W power cap --background GPU power capped at 200 W for the run --background host: i9-9960X, 123 GiB RAM, Ubuntu 26.04, driver 595.99.02
